title: 6. Goals & Motivation
use_cases: Use when developing complex character motivations and moral boundaries
Configure when defining a character's unique voice and speech patterns
Implement when creating behavioral consistency through daily routines and habits
Use when establishing driving internal conflicts and betrayal triggers
Use when detailing sensory habits like diet, domesticity, and hobbies
Implement when mapping out character progression from short-term to long-term goals
